### CVE-2026-0485 — Denial of service (DOS) vulnerability in SAP BusinessObjects BI Platform
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2026-02-10 | Updated: 2026-02-10 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-405 CWE-405: Asymmetric Resource Consumption
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

SAP BusinessObjects BI Platform allows an unauthenticated attacker to send specially crafted requests that could cause the Content Management Server (CMS) to crash and automatically restart. By repeatedly submitting these requests, the attacker could induce a persistent service disruption, rendering the CMS completely unavailable. Successful exploitation results in a high impact on availability, while confidentiality and integrity remain unaffected.

Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP BusinessObjects BI Platform: affected ENTERPRISE 430; affected 2025; affected 2027

References:
- https://me.sap.com/notes/3678282
- https://url.sap/sapsecuritypatchday

### CVE-2026-0487 — DLL Hijacking vulnerability in SAProuter on Microsoft Windows
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2026-07-14 | Updated: 2026-07-20 | Max CVSS: 8.4
- CWE: CWE-427 CWE-427: Uncontrolled Search Path Element
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.4 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

SAProuter on Microsoft Windows allows an unauthenticated attacker to load library (DLL) files from an untrusted location, allowing them to execute malicious code on the system. This could enable the attacker to hijack the DLL loading process and achieve arbitrary code execution. This has high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability of the system.

Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAProuter on Microsoft Windows: affected KRNL64NUC 7.22; affected 7.22EXT; affected KRNL64UC 7.22; affected 7.53; affected SAP_ROUTER 7.53; affected 7.54; affected KERNEL 7.22; affected 7.77; affected 7.89; affected 7.93; affected 9.16; affected 9.17; affected 9.18

### CVE-2026-0491 — Code Injection vulnerability in SAP Landscape Transformation
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2026-01-13 | Updated: 2026-02-26 | Max CVSS: 9.1
- CWE: CWE-94 CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.1 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

SAP Landscape Transformation allows an attacker with admin privileges to exploit a vulnerability in the function module exposed via RFC. This flaw enables the injection of arbitrary ABAP code/OS commands into the system, bypassing essential authorization checks. This vulnerability effectively functions as a backdoor, creating the risk of full system compromise, undermining the confidentiality, integrity and availability of the system.

Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP Landscape Transformation: affected DMIS 2011_1_700; affected 2011_1_710; affected 2011_1_730; affected 2011_1_731; affected 2018_1_752; affected 2020

### CVE-2026-89111 — OAuth2 SSRF vulnerability in SAP Cloud SDK for Python
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2026-10-13 | Updated: 2026-11-03 | Max CVSS: 10
- CWE: CWE-918 CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 10 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

The SAP Cloud SDK for Python contains an OAuth2 SSRF vulnerability affecting multi-tenant BTP applications. An attacker who controls the tenant_subdomain parameter can redirect OAuth2 token requests to an attacker-controlled server, causing client credentials to be exfiltrated.



This vulnerability was originally fixed in 0.45.2. It was reintroduced in 0.53.0 when the HTTP client was refactored into a shared core module, and the tenant subdomain validation was not carried over to the new location. The validation was restored in 0.55.1.

Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP Cloud: affected sap-cloud-sdk < 0.45.2; affected >=0.53.0 <0.55.1 (custom)

### CVE-2026-109799 — Improper verification of JWT signature in IASContextProvider leads to tenant/user identity spoofing ( sap-cloud-sdk (pip))
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2026-11-10 | Updated: 2026-11-10 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-347 CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

The SAP Cloud SDK for Python contains an improper cryptographic signature verification vulnerability (CWE-347) in IASContextProvider, the runtime-context provider registered by default via bootstrap(app).IASContextProvider extracted the app_tid, sap_gtid and user_uuid claims from the IAS JWT in the Authorization header using an unverified decoder and wrote them into the request-scoped RuntimeContext without validating the token signature. A remote caller could submit a self-signed JWT naming a victim tenant/user; the forged identity then propagated to every consumer of the runtime context:OTel span attributes (sap.tenancy.tenant_id, user.id) via RuntimeContextSpanProcessorlog records via IdentityLogFilteraudit events (tenant_id, user_initiator_id) via AuditClienttenant routing via CBCClientThis completes an earlier remediation that fixed the same unverified pattern in StarletteIASTelemetryMiddleware but did not cover IASContextProvider.

Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP Cloud SDK for Python: affected < 0.63.1

References:
- https://github.com/SAP/cloud-sdk-python/security/advisories/GHSA-93m8-crj2-v997
- https://url.sap/sapsecuritypatchday

### CVE-2026-120013 — Path Traversal in Agent Memory Module of SAP Cloud SDK for Python
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2026-11-10 | Updated: 2026-11-10 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-22 CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N`

The agent_memory module accepts a caller-supplied tenant parameter in create_client(tenant=...). Prior to version 0.50.0, the tenant parameter was not validated before being used to construct filesystem paths for secret resolution. A value containing path traversal sequences (for example, attacker-corp/../victim-corp) could cause the resolved path to escape the intended directory and access another tenant's secrets under:Plain Text/etc/secrets/appfnd/hana-agent-memory/<tenant>/Successful exploitation could allow unauthorized access to another tenant's mounted credentials, including OAuth client IDs and client secrets. This vulnerability could enable cross-tenant access to sensitive credentials.

Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP Cloud SDK for Python: affected < 0.50.0

References:
- https://github.com/SAP/cloud-sdk-python/security/advisories/GHSA-28c8-457r-4cf6
- https://url.sap/sapsecuritypatchday
